title: SS27 Kids' Knit Fabric Direction
summary: Organic cotton jersey and interlock, terry, micro-mesh, and UPF-rated performance and swim fabrics for SS27 kidswear.

sections.heading: The evidence
sections.body: Terry and micro-mesh are among Fatamadrina's SS27 fabrics<sup>[1]</sup>; MilK chose a terry top<sup>[2]</sup>. Salt and Pepper describes its SS27 fabrics as sustainable organic cotton, "exceptionally soft and gentle on the skin"<sup>[3]</sup>. Cadhan uses soft organic cotton for pyjamas<sup>[4]</sup>. Teeter Totter uses performance fabrics with responsible materials and UPF50+ protection; Piccoli Principi uses technical fabrics including sustainable lycra<sup>[4]</sup>. Newer lines emphasise breathability and quick drying<sup>[5]</sup>.

sections.heading: Fabric by fabric
sections.body:
| Knit | Hand | Uses |
|---|---|---|
| Organic cotton jersey | Soft | Tees, sets |
| Interlock | Smooth, stable | Baby, pyjamas |
| Terry | Soft, absorbent | Tops, shorts, cover-ups |
| Micro-mesh | Light, airy | Sport, layers |
| UPF swim and performance knits | Stretch, quick-dry | Swim, rash guards |

design_implications:
- Test UPF after stretch and wet, when protection can drop.
- Safety: no drawstrings or long cords at the hood, neck or waist of young children's clothing, in line with EN 14682; test the attachment strength of buttons, beads, shells and other decorations, and keep small detachable parts off baby and toddler pieces.
commercial_implications: - Organic cotton basics support repeat purchase; UPF supports full price.
